description: A signed-in-record, machine-readable correction slip. HONESTY LABEL: tamper-evident hash chain, NOT cryptographic signing. CWI holds no signing keys.

affected_citations.description: Agent URNs or document ids that cited the old version.

corrected_claim.description: The corrected claim, stated plainly as the current version of record.

fact_id.description: Stable identifier of the fact being corrected, e.g. fact-spotify-track-id-zooted-zone.

issuer_urn.description: Agent URN from the CWI agent roster. Provenance-by-roster, not cryptographic identity.

prev_hash.description: SHA-256 of the previous slip, or the literal string GENESIS for the first slip.

retraction_note.description: Factual, neutral note: what happened, when caught, whether anything shipped with the old claim.

slip_hash.description: SHA-256 over canonical (sorted-keys, compact) JSON of all other fields.

slip_id.description: Sequential id assigned at issue time, e.g. slip-0001.

superseded_text.description: Verbatim (or nearest-record) text of the old, now-retracted claim. Never paraphrased away.

supersedes.description: Identifier of the old claim (claim id, brief id, or 'unrecorded'), e.g. claim-brief-20260916-001.

title: CorrectionSlip
